items.t: hi i’ve been struggling a lot this past year with developing ME. i had a bad flu around christmas last year and i noticed very pronounced PEM begin in february-march. i was hoping to ask if you have any advice for going about talking to family & doctors about needing additional support and how to get it. i was already disabled from other (genetic, degenerative) chronic illness before that (possibly my immune system was not at its best in the first place hence the flu) so i had some supports in place already but i am much sicker now and it feels like everything that was hard but doable before is now miserably difficult. it’s hard to walk anywhere, even at home, and i’m completely homebound because my previous manual wheelchair is not enough to let me leave the house without support. chronic nausea that was unpleasant before is now making me completely miserable every time i try to eat. my pain is much worse, and it’s hard to spend even a couple hours out of bed. i’m not really trying to vent (apologies if you just don’t really need to hear about my pity party) but i’m hoping to give useful context. i need more support than i have right now, i think. my friends are starting to suggest i ask my doctors about nutrition support, but i don’t know what to ask for or how to get it. it just feels really hard because since i’ve started to have PEM it is hard to think every day so being able to even accomplish phone calls and manage appointments to keep my ducks in a row on my own is really hard. so, i was just hoping to ask for any advice you have on where to go when illness gets more severe and how to get support because i feel like i am drowning and don’t have what i need thank you so much for your blog and your time <3
